page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-4x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM to accelerate parallel processing workloads. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-speed data transfers between the instance and external storage or other network resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn8t-4x.16xlarge represents a high-density hardware profile that balances substantial CPU resources with dedicated GPU acceleration and a large memory footprint. This configuration is designed for workloads that require significant parallel computing power and memory capacity, such as deep learning training, AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex data visualization tasks.
